plan.discovery_rule: At least four added wins/60, with parent exceeding four gear in at least three classes and candidate never exceeding four. Audit every discovery replay for accepted purchases and every state hash.
plan.validation_rule: 120 independent seeds, 12/class. Gain>=.05 over Duelist and >=.10 over default, paired exact p<.025 each. No adverse Bonferroni flag for win, timeout, death rate or level overall/by class; equipment reduction is the intended tradeoff and reported separately.
plan.stop_rule: No validation unless discovery qualifies; freeze one cap=4 candidate. No early stopping, additional candidates, reused seeds or changed thresholds. Hosted field comparison required before league promotion.
plan.authorization: User 2026-09-10: update the policy on softmax league when ready; local-first preference persists.
